description: Curated FRED/ALFRED series panel feeding the estimation layer. Edit `national` and `state_families`, then run `python3 data/fred_macro_panel/build_config.py` (needs FRED_API_KEY) to refresh `series` metadata/vintage windows and the acquisition combinations in dataset.json.

tiers.vintages: ALFRED: every real-time vintage (realtime_start 1776-07-04 .. 9999-12-31, split into windows of <=1900 vintage dates); for point-in-time backtests (all panel series since the 100 GiB budget update)
tiers.as_of: Values in effect on `as_of` plus every revision published after it (realtime_start=as_of .. 9999-12-31); realtime_start earlier than as_of is clipped to as_of; used for licensed third-party series (Moody's, Freddie Mac, CBOE, S&P, NASDAQ, University of Michigan), which FRED does not serve as ALFRED vintage history
